cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful promotion. Come to the head of the table; I'll lead the toast. Such beautiful timing with the director's retirement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I worked for this. It wasn't just timing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Your patience has been splendidly rewarded by someone finally leaving you a chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you just be happy for me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Delighted. Take the chair while I raise my glass. I look forward to seeing what you do with the opportunity the rest of us were still waiting to be offered.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 leads the toast and assigns the seat; A3 credits vacancy rather than achievement; A5 directs the promotion celebration while revealing competing aspirants.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2 work claim with praise of patience; A5 answers B4 happiness request with delighted words and the waiting comparison.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants effort recognized and B4 asks for uncomplicated happiness; both are plausible responses to poisoned congratulations.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 request to perform delight while locating A among those still waiting for the same opportunity.

specificity.evidence: A1 workplace promotion toast establishes table and retired director; no precise company history is needed.
